author: JCoIe
body:
Hello all! Today a couple friends and I build this spaced themed map. 

This map is very fun and exciting to play, there are two monuments, one under ground through a cave and another on a planets to the right of spawn. There are some chest scattered around the main island and the most advanced Armour would be iron, no diamonds!



The glass would represent a helmet for a player and the gold boots has feather falling 2, and the leather armor would be the same color as one team.
The spade has sharpness 2.

The teams are Orange and Yellow.

Yml   http://pastie.org/9310283
Download
Images  {Album - http://imgur.com/a/bn3NU}
